regime.summary: Policy rate 9.75% is below CPI 12.24% and the 6M bill sits 2.75pp above the policy rate, so the curve prices hikes the SBP has not made. CPI is rising, Brent is +63% in 3 months, the rupee is weakening. The 2017-19 squeeze lesson says read the rate and rupee. Stay light, hold only what is at highs.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 9.75%; last MPC decision 2022-03-08: hold (+0bp)
6M T-bill minus policy rate +2.75pp (market pricing hikes)
Balance-of-payments squeeze and hike cycle: the index fell 46% to the August 2019 low

core.thesis: Fertilizer is the only sector with names at 252-day highs while the rest of the market is falling. EFERT is at its high with 3m +20.8%. Breakout base rate is only a hypothesis, so the size stays small. Hiking regime caps conviction.
